title: Pesto Chicken with Almonds
description: A flavorful and healthy dish made with grilled chicken, pesto sauce, and toasted almonds.
instructions: Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
Grill chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast almonds in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes, or until fragrant.
Stir pesto into almonds and cook for 1 minute.
Serve chicken with pesto-almond sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with additional almonds if desired.
